To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
WNV and USUTV serological positive birds and horses were detected in Poland.
WNV serological prevalence in horses and birds was 35.7% and 15.08%, respectively.
the seroprevelance of WNV and Usutu viruses in birds and in equids in Poland was low.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the first report of WNV and the first report of USUV in birds in Poland.
the first detection of WNV and of USUV in horses and birds in Poland.
the epidemiological situation of WNV and of USUV in Poland.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presence of WNV and of USUV in Poland is confirmed.
both WNV and USU virus are present in Poland and that they are circulating in both horses and birds, which is of public health importance.
the risk of WNV and, especially, USUV transmission is present in Poland.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presence of WNV and/or USUV in Poland should be monitored and that there is a need for a comprehensive surveillance program for both of these arboviruses.
the WNV and USU virus are present in Poland and the risk of infection in humans is high.
the presence of WNV and/or USUV in birds or horses in Poland is a risk factor for the emergence of these viruses in the country.
The main takeaway from our work is that
WNV and USU are circulating in Poland, and there is a need to monitor the situation and to implement active control programs.
both viruses are circulating in Poland.
the risk of WNV and Usutu viruses in horses and wild birds in Poland is high and should be considered by veterinarians and public health professionals.
